abstract: Fifty-three patients presenting with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT) of the testis were examined. Particular interest was directed towards the association of several morphological features of the primary tumour with metastatic disease, either at presentation or later in the course of the tumour. It is apparent from this study that the presence of vascular invasion in the primary tumour, high T stage (advanced local disease) and the presence of choriocarcinoma are poor prognostic signs in NSGCT. In such tumours presenting as clinical stage I, surveillance management may not be appropriate because of the high rate of relapse.
abstract_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）患者53例を対象に、原発腫瘍のいくつかの形態学的特徴と、診断時あるいはその後の経過における転移性疾患との関連を検討した。本研究から、原発腫瘍における脈管侵襲、高いT病期（局所進展の進んだ病態）、および絨毛癌の存在が予後不良の所見であることが明らかになった。臨床病期Iとして提示された症例では、再発率が高いため監視療法は適切でない可能性がある。
